messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: Sev2 - High error rate in SaasCorp VPC (dedicated pool) - 1742009876

ops-oncall: Taking this. pinging ben to join. Observed increased 500s from tx-proxy in SaasCorp dedicated pool. Initial triage: some request bodies appear without redaction markers.

ben (oncall): on it. can someone confirm if the customer's log retention override is active? I sampled S3 and I see full request bodies in a few objects.

eve (Infra Eng): We have a log redaction pipeline that runs async. For VPC customers we normally strip PII before shipping. Looks like a pipeline failure between extractor -> redactor. I'm pulling the consumer logs now. @faye can you contact CS?

faye (Redwood Support): @dave from SaasCorp said they're in the middle of a large rolling import and might have sensitive user data in flight. They asked us to avoid external disclosure.

ops-oncall: We need a temporary exception to retain unredacted logs for triage, but keep them isolated and encrypted. Legal sign-off required. @carla please advise on permissible retention window and required controls.

carla (Legal): Short answer: we can allow a narrowly scoped exception for up to 24 hours for incident response if it's logged in audit and we have customer consent or documented emergency approval. Must minimize access, use KMS, and schedule automatic purge. Draft the approval details (bucket/prefix, principals, TTL) and post here.

ben (oncall): Proposal: create ephemeral S3 prefix saascorp-incidents/1742009876/ in our secured account, server-side encrypt with customer KMS alias if available, restrict IAM to ops-oncall, ben, and eve for 24h, and add a Lifecycle delete after 24h. Tag objects with redaction-exception=true and write an audit event redaction-exception-granted with ticket ID.

dave (Customer Success): SaasCorp approves emergency access. They emailed security@saascorp.com confirming emergency access for triage. I will attach the confirmation to the ticket. They want the logs deleted after triage.

carla (Legal): Good. I need the S3 prefix path, exact list of Redwood principals, the TTL, and assurance that we won't use the retained data for analytics or backups. Also attach the customer's email (redact any unrelated PII) to the ticket.

eve (Infra Eng): Executing steps now. Command I will run: ```
aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-incident-logs --key saascorp-incidents/1742009876/placeholder.txt --server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/saascorp-kms
```
Then I'll apply a bucket policy restricting GetObject to the three principals. Posting the policy snippet when ready.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: Ben / Eve please also set a redaction-exception flag in the incident DB so downstream purge picks it up. Reason: pipeline redactor OOM. Adding incident note link: ticket 2024-INC-332.

ben (oncall): policy applied, prefix created, IAM restriction in place. Confirmed Lifecycle rule: Expire objects after 1 day (24h). Tagged objects with redaction-exception=true.

faye (Redwood Support): I have DM'd SaasCorp that we have emergency access and will delete after 24h. They confirmed and asked us not to share any PII in replies.

carla (Legal): Approve. Legal sign-off recorded: carla@redwood. Ensure audit trail shows who accessed what, when, and which KMS key was used. Also capture the customer email in the ticket.

ops-oncall: We're starting analysis. If we need longer than 24h we'll make a second documented request with justification and exec approval. Handoff to ben for deeper debug.

ben (oncall): Handoff: continuing in thread. Initial logs show the redactor consumer crashed with OOM at 04:12 UTC and backlog wasn't processed. Relevant error: ```
Exception: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError at com.redwood.redactor.Main.processLine(Main.java:243)
```
Also seeing raw payloads containing email addresses and phone numbers.

eve (Infra Eng): Scaling the redactor consumer group and enabling backfill job. Will monitor memory usage and backpressure. If backfill completes we'll run a safe-redact pass to replace PII in retained artifacts before deletion.

ops-oncall: Noted. Please add access entries to audit log: access: saascorp-incidents/1742009876/* by ben@redwood, eve@redwood, ops-oncall@redwood with timestamps. Ensure no snapshots or backups are taken of the prefix.

ben (oncall): Access entries created and pushed to ticket 2024-INC-332. Doing triage now, will post a summary in ~2 hours. Leaving thread open.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVED ticket 1742009876 - SaasCorp redactor pipeline OOM - mitigation deployed, backlog processed, retained logs scheduled for purge.

ops-oncall: Closing after purge completed. Final note: logs purged at 1742011000, audit entries saved in ticket. Thanks everyone for quick action.
